whatWasProven: src/office/xlsx.js builds a two-sheet workbook entirely in process with no subprocess and no binary workspace write
openpyxl opens the result: sheets Model and Notes
numeric cells keep type n, formula cells keep type f with the exact expressions
text cells round-trip exactly, including the TECHNICAL_TEST_ONLY note
every ZIP entry carries a matching CRC32 and the archive is stored-only
whatWasNotProven: delivery of these bytes into the workspace (no binary write seam)
recalculation of the formulas (no usable confined subprocess)
